blocks.text: LoopsKey helps professionals plan, complete, track, and report their learning in one place.

Many professionals need to maintain certifications, complete CPD/PDU requirements, attend training, collect certificates, and prepare annual progress summaries. LoopsKey brings these activities together in a simple AI-powered platform.
What Professionals Can Do with LoopsKey
Search and save relevant learning opportunities
Track CPD, PDU, CEU, or training hours
View upcoming deadlines in the calendar
Receive learning recommendations based on goals and profile
LoopsKey helps users define a professional learning goal and generate a structured roadmap. The roadmap may include courses, webinars, events, articles, podcasts, workshops, and milestones.
Users can update their roadmap based on skill level, preferred topics, available time, and certification needs.
LoopsKey helps professionals track annual development requirements by recording completed learning activities and credit values.

After attending a course, event, webinar, meeting, or other learning activity, users can add the activity to their LoopsKey dashboard. They can include title, type, date, duration, credit value, CPD/PDU category, notes, and proof files.
Use LoopsKey to organize your learning, track your progress, and stay prepared for your next certification or licence renewal.
LoopsKey helps professional associations, certification bodies, and licensing organizations support member learning, CPD/PDU progress, and professional development reporting.

Associations often need to help members understand requirements, complete training, track progress, and submit evidence. LoopsKey provides a digital platform that supports both members and administrators.
Assign required or recommended learning content
View members who are on track or behind
Improve member engagement with personalized recommendations
Each professional member can receive a personalized dashboard to track learning activities, CPD/PDU progress, certificates, deadlines, and recommended content.
Association administrators can view member progress, assign content, manage learning requirements, and access summary reports.

LoopsKey helps organizations support employee learning, professional development, certification tracking, and workforce skill growth.

Companies and HR teams often need visibility into employee learning activities, training progress, certificates, and development goals. LoopsKey provides a centralized platform to help organizations guide and monitor professional learning.

LoopsKey can help employees build learning roadmaps based on their roles, goals, skill level, and available time. These roadmaps can support onboarding, upskilling, leadership development, compliance training, or career growth.

Welcome to the LoopsKey Help Center. This page provides guidance for using LoopsKey’s main features, including professional profiles, learning roadmaps, CPD/PDU tracking, learning activities, certificates, and calendar planning.
Users can create a LoopsKey account using supported login methods such as email or LinkedIn. After login, users can complete their Professional Profile and start building a learning plan.
The Professional Profile section stores basic and professional information used to personalize the platform.
The My Roadmap section helps users create a personalized learning path based on goals, skill level, interests, preferred format, and available time.
The CPD/PDU Progress section helps users track professional development requirements for certification or licence renewal.
The My Learning Activities section stores completed learning records.
The Certificates section stores certificate and proof documents. Users can upload, view, and manage files related to learning activities, certifications, and licence renewals.
The Calendar section helps users organize upcoming learning events, roadmap milestones, deadlines, reminders, and certificate expiry dates.

LoopsKey aims to protect user information through reasonable technical and organizational safeguards, including:

LoopsKey does not sell uploaded certificate or proof documents.

Welcome to LoopsKey. These Terms of Use govern access to and use of the LoopsKey website, platform, applications, and related services. LoopsKey is owned and operated by Nexel Chain Inc., a Canadian company. By using LoopsKey, users agree to these Terms. If users do not agree, they should not use the platform.

LoopsKey is an AI-powered professional learning and development platform that helps users discover learning opportunities, create learning roadmaps, track CPD/PDU progress, manage certificates, organize calendar items, and maintain professional development records.

Some features require an account. Users are responsible for keeping login credentials secure and for ensuring that profile, certification, CPD/PDU, and learning activity information is accurate and current.

LoopsKey may suggest CPD, PDU, CEU, or other professional development requirements based on publicly available information, association-provided information, or user-declared information. LoopsKey is a tracking and support tool and does not replace official association, licensing body, employer, or certification provider requirements. Users are responsible for confirming final requirements with the relevant organization.

LoopsKey may use AI to support keyword extraction, content classification, learning recommendations, roadmap creation, CPD/PDU suggestions, and summaries. AI-generated outputs are provided for guidance only and should be reviewed by users before relying on them.

Users may upload certificates, attendance proof, learning records, or other documents. Users are responsible for ensuring they have the right to upload and store these materials. LoopsKey may process uploaded files to provide certificate management, learning activity tracking, and related services.

LoopsKey may display learning content from third-party providers, including courses, events, webinars, workshops, articles, and other resources. LoopsKey is not responsible for third-party availability, pricing, quality, accreditation, or outcomes unless expressly stated.
Users agree not to misuse the platform, attempt unauthorized access, upload harmful content, interfere with platform security, or use LoopsKey for unlawful purposes.
Some LoopsKey features may require payment or subscription. Pricing, billing terms, cancellation rules, and refund policies will be provided at the time of purchase where applicable.
LoopsKey may update these Terms from time to time. Updated Terms will be posted on this page with a revised date.
For questions about these Terms, contact LoopsKey at loopskey.dev@gmail.com.

LoopsKey may use AI services to support content classification, keyword extraction, roadmap generation, recommendations, CPD/PDU suggestions, and learning summaries. Where possible, LoopsKey limits the information sent to AI services to the minimum information needed for the requested function.

LoopsKey does not sell personal information. Limited information may be shared with service providers who help operate the platform, payment processors where applicable, authentication providers if a user chooses third-party login, organizations or associations when authorized or connected by the user, and legal authorities if required by law.

If a user connects their account to an association, employer, licensing body, or organization account, certain progress, CPD/PDU, certificate, or learning activity information may become visible to that organization according to the applicable settings, agreement, or program rules.

LoopsKey is a worldwide product. Users may access the platform from different countries, and privacy rights may vary by location. LoopsKey aims to handle personal information responsibly and provide appropriate user choices where required by applicable law.

LoopsKey uses reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect user information, including access controls, secure storage, and operational monitoring. Information is retained as long as needed to provide services, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and maintain business records.

LoopsKey is an AI-powered professional learning and CPD/PDU tracking platform owned by Nexel Chain Inc.

LoopsKey helps professionals plan, complete, track, and report their learning in one place. The platform supports personalized learning roadmaps, training recommendations, certificate management, calendar planning, and CPD/PDU progress tracking.
Our mission is to make professional development more organized, personalized, and accessible for learners around the world.

Our vision is to become a trusted global platform for professional learning intelligence, connecting learners, associations, organizations, and content providers through AI-powered planning and tracking tools.
LoopsKey works with professional associations, licensing bodies, and certification organizations that want to improve member learning, CPD/PDU tracking, and professional development engagement.
Associations can use LoopsKey to help members stay informed, organized, and on track with development requirements.
LoopsKey gives associations a modern way to support members beyond traditional communication and manual reporting.
